```{r make dge list}

if (!exists('t2t_XISTclean_se')) {
 t2t_XISTclean_se <- read_rds(here('t2t_XISTclean_se.rds'))
}

XISTclean_meta <- colData(t2t_XISTclean_se) %>% as.data.frame() 
XISTclean_counts <- t2t_XISTclean_se %>% assays() %>% .[['counts']] %>% `rownames<-`(rowData(t2t_XISTclean_se)$ID) 
```




```{r make dge list}
if (!exists('t2t_dge')) {
  filter_mmx <- model.matrix(~ poly(XCD,2) + YCD, data = XISTclean_meta)
  t2t_keep <- filterByExpr(XISTclean_counts, design =  filter_mmx)
#  t2t_keep <- rowSums(cpm(XISTclean_counts) > 0.1) >= 5
  t2t_dge <- XISTclean_counts[t2t_keep,] %>% DGEList()
  t2t_dge <- calcNormFactors(t2t_dge)
}
#t2t_dge$counts %>% dim() # 21148    82
```

```{r}
t2t_form <- ~ poly(XCD, 2) + YCD + (1|DNU_id)
t2t_vobj <- voomWithDreamWeights(t2t_dge, t2t_form, XISTclean_meta, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4, "SOCK", progressbar = TRUE))
t2t_fit <- variancePartition::dream(t2t_vobj, t2t_form, XISTclean_meta)
t2t_fit  <- variancePartition::eBayes(t2t_fit)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(t2t_vobj, here('t2t_vobj.rds'))
saveRDS(t2t_fit, here('t2t_fit.rds'))

```

```{r YCD as factor}
#for excluding the Y-linked linear genes absent in the 2 to 1 contrast
XISTclean_meta$YCD_F <- as.factor(XISTclean_meta$YCD) %>% fct_relevel('1')
Yf_form <- ~ poly(XCD, 2) + YCD_F + (1|DNU_id)

Yf_vobj <-voomWithDreamWeights(t2t_dge , Yf_form, XISTclean_meta)
Yf_fit <- dream(Yf_vobj, Yf_form, XISTclean_meta)
Yf_fit <- variancePartition::eBayes(Yf_fit)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(Yf_fit, here('Yf_fit.rds'))
```

```{r}

XCDL_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(t2t_fit, coef = 'poly(XCD, 2)1', number = Inf)
XCDQ_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(t2t_fit, coef = 'poly(XCD, 2)2', number = Inf)

Yf_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(Yf_fit, coef = 'YCD_F2', number = Inf) 

YCD_mm <- 
  variancePartition::topTable(t2t_fit, coef = 'YCD', number = Inf) %>%
  mutate(sig2to1 = 
    case_when(
      rownames(.) %in% rownames(Yf_mm[Yf_mm$adj.P.Val <= 0.05,])  ~ 'yes',
      rownames(.) %in% rownames(Yf_mm[Yf_mm$adj.P.Val > 0.05,]) ~ 'no',                       ,
      .default = NA)
    )

t2t_mm <- list(
  XCDL_mm = XCDL_mm,
  XCDQ_mm = XCDQ_mm,
  YCD_mm = YCD_mm
) 

saveRDS(t2t_mm, here('t2t_mm.rds'))
```

```{r}
coefficients(t2t_fit) %>% colnames()
```
